narrative:
October is the winter inbound month, and it shows. Value under close is up 6.6% on September and supplier invoices are up 14%, as alpine, cross-country and outerwear stock lands ahead of the November peak. Proposed accruals total NOK 58.1M. Supplier rebates and goods received not invoiced make up NOK 30.6M, holiday pay and leases NOK 11.3M.

The Flux Commentary Agent has drafted an explanation for every close feed from the underlying transactions: which stores, which categories, which suppliers drove the movement. The chain controllers review and edit the drafts instead of writing them in spreadsheets on WD+5.

Three accrual proposals need a decision: GRNI on 312 open purchase orders, holiday pay on seasonal winter staff, and a higher shrink provision after East cycle counts.

signals.title: Winter season build — inbound plan
signals.excerpt: Alpine, cross-country and outerwear inbound peaks in October ahead of November and December trading. GRNI and rebate accruals are largest in this window.

signals.title: October cycle counts — East region
signals.excerpt: Four East stores report 1.8% shrink vs 1.1% budget, concentrated in electronics and ski goggles. Store owners asked to recount.

signals.title: Reliance on external consultants
signals.excerpt: Close workarounds depend on consultant scripts with limited documentation. Knowledge leaves when consultants roll off.
